tagline.en: MIRA — a multiplayer, action-conditioned world model for offline inference on the Rocket Science dataset.
tagline.zh: MIRA——面向多玩家、动作条件的世界模型,在 Rocket Science 数据集上做离线推理。

en: MIRA is an action-conditioned, multiplayer interactive world model. It rolls a world forward from actions, and is designed around multiplayer game-world scenarios.

WorldFoundry vendors the upstream inference source and exposes offline inference only — there's no training or metric entrypoint. You run it against a local MIRA checkpoint and a local split of the Rocket Science dataset (which must include its index.json).
In WorldFoundry you point the workspace at your staged checkpoint and dataset split, and it generates a Rocket Science rollout, using the shared video backend for decoding and output.
zh: MIRA 是一个动作条件、多玩家的交互式世界模型。它从动作出发向前推演世界,围绕多玩家游戏世界场景设计。
WorldFoundry 内置了上游的推理源码,只暴露离线推理——不含训练或指标入口。你需要用本地 MIRA checkpoint 和本地的 Rocket Science 数据集切片(须包含其 index.json)来运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把工作区指向已就位的 checkpoint 与数据集切片,它便生成一段 Rocket Science rollout,并使用统一视频后端进行解码与输出。

whenToUse.en: Use MIRA when you want to explore an action-conditioned, multiplayer world model offline and you already have a compatible checkpoint and a local Rocket Science split to run against.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想离线探索一个动作条件、多玩家的世界模型,并且已备有兼容的 checkpoint 与本地 Rocket Science 切片时,适合使用 MIRA。

notFor.en: It's inference-only — no training or evaluation entrypoint is included. It requires a local checkpoint and a local Rocket Science split; the full public dataset is very large and is not downloaded automatically.
notFor.zh: 它只做推理——不含训练或评测入口。运行需要本地 checkpoint 与本地 Rocket Science 切片;完整公开数据集体量极大,不会自动下载。

en: Offline inference only — training and metrics are intentionally omitted
Runs against a local checkpoint and Rocket Science dataset split
Uses WorldFoundry's shared video backend for decoding and output
zh: 动作条件的多玩家交互式世界模型
仅离线推理——刻意不含训练与指标入口
基于本地 checkpoint 与 Rocket Science 数据集切片运行
使用 WorldFoundry 统一视频后端进行解码与输出
